{
  "name": "backend",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "bun run --watch src/index.ts",
    "build": "bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun",
    "start": "bun run migrate && bun dist/index.js",
    "migrate": "bun run src/db/migrate.ts",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate",
    "db:migrate": "bun run migrate"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@elysiajs/cors": "^1.2.0",
    "@elysiajs/static": "^1.2.0",
    "drizzle-orm": "^0.39.3",
    "elysia": "^1.2.25",
    "zod": "^3.24.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/bun": "^1.2.4",
    "drizzle-kit": "^0.30.4",
    "typescript": "^5.8.2"
  }
}
